claim_boundary: DIRAC-010 is the highest passed research gate. The native action contains only the positive local and exterior-area C19 energies for two complex C3 fields. Lean derives the native update and first-order state map, factors the isotropic quadratic C19 continuum symbol through cubical Clifford geometry with an explicit fourth-order lattice remainder, retains both rank-four copies, and proves exact invertible maps to the conventional Dirac alpha/beta representation. The physical mass coefficient, full continuum time-evolution theorem, current, spin and electron remain open.
